display.purpose: Primary screen headings and major statements.

secondary.purpose: Metadata, helper copy, and amount qualifiers.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Structural priority on summary and focus cards.

motion.name: micro

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast native action used once per focused state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #202129; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.4px; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(53,106,154,0.36); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Savings Action
components.description: Confirms an external transfer to savings.
components.css: .ds-btn-savings { min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #28D985; color: #042B1B; font: 900 16px/20px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 10px rgba(40,217,133,0.24); transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-savings:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-savings:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-savings:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,217,133,0.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Debt Action
components.css: .ds-btn-debt { min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #FF657B; color: #30030A; font: 900 16px/20px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 10px rgba(255,101,123,0.22); transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-debt:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-debt:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-debt:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,101,123,0.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Destination
components.description: Two-state destination selector with one filled active pill.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ECEEF2; } .ds-segment button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 14px/18px Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-segment-active { background: #202129; color: #F5F6F8; } .ds-segment-idle { background: transparent; color: #202129; } .ds-segment button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(53,106,154,0.36); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Focus Card
components.description: Single-destination card containing progress art, amount, and supporting metrics.
components.css: .ds-focus-card { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #D8DCE3; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202129; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(25,27,34,0.05); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-focus-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-focus-card strong { font-size: 27px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-focus-card span { margin-left: 7px; color: #626774; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-focus-art { height: 182px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #F5F6F8; }

components.name: Money Input
components.description: Bordered numeric field used in transfer and debt setup sheets.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #202129; font: 700 13px/17px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #D8DCE3; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202129; font: 700 17px/22px Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #356A9A; outline: 3px solid rgba(53,106,154,0.18); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Bottom Proof Sheet
components.description: Scrollable native sheet for the bank handoff, amount, and screenshot verification.
components.html:
Confirm transfer

Transfer in your bank, then add proof.
components.css: .ds-sheet { padding: 10px 16px 16px; border: 1px solid #D8DCE3; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #202129; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px rgba(17,19,24,0.14); } .ds-sheet-handle { width: 40px; height: 4px; margin: 0 auto 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #D8DCE3; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 21px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 0; color: #626774; font-size: 13px; line-height: 19px; }

narrative.overview: Almost should feel like a calm, credible companion at the moment a user turns an intention into action. The interface uses cool neutral grounds, bright semantic surfaces, decisive type hierarchy, and a small number of recognizable product assets. It is supportive without posing as a bank, and expressive without letting illustration compete with the task. The visual system is native, compact, and behavior-first. Each screen presents one dominant state or action, then uses secondary cards and lightweight line icons to explain what happens next. Light, dark, and PRO are equal product modes rather than recolored afterthoughts.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral backgrounds with clear, bright content surfaces.
Heavy Inter numerals and titles paired with quieter explanatory text.
Semantic savings, debt, and information colors used only where meaning is stable.
Soft cards, restrained ambient depth, and platform-sized touch targets.
Existing Almost assets used as progress objects or helpers, never as unrelated decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Destination Rule
rules.body: Green means savings and verified accumulation; red means debt payment or debt burden. Do not swap them for novelty.

rules.name: The Theme Role Rule
rules.body: Components consume semantic theme roles rather than hardcoding a light-only palette.

rules.name: The Number Leads Rule
rules.body: On money surfaces, the amount is the strongest text; its qualifier stays adjacent and subordinate.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case for actions and labels. Uppercase is reserved for existing compact status patterns, not page hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with semantic surfaces and borders before adding shadow.

dos: Do use one clear focal action per state and show the real-world handoff before asking for proof.
Do reuse the semantic theme roles in light, dark, and PRO, including every configured PRO accent.
Do keep money values tabular, prominent, localized, and paired with an explicit meaning.
Do use existing Almost art when it explains progress or provides contextual help.
Do preserve reduced motion, RTL, Dynamic Type, screen-reader labels, and native dismissal behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a Budget action to spend; Budget has savings and debt destinations only.
Don't imply Almost holds or transfers money. The user's external bank or deposit service performs the transaction.
Don't replace product assets and semantic surfaces with random glossy fintech art, generic charts, or unrelated gradients.
Don't use illustration as filler when task state, amount, or the next action needs the space.
Don't remove, hide, or visually demote an existing flow to simplify a redesign.
